description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of time savings achieved through the implementation of “Paper Copilot,” specifically showing the contributions of “Reduction” and “Efficient deployment.” The chart contains two slices, with the larger slice labeled “Reduction” and colored a shade of brown, representing approximately 69.92% or 60.9s. The second slice, labeled “Efficient deployment,” is colored blue and represents approximately 30.08% or 26.2s. Percentage labels are displayed inside each slice, and the “Efficient deployment” slice is slightly offset from the rest of the chart. A legend is not present, but the labels directly correspond to the slices. The slices appear ordered from largest to smallest based on their proportional size.
